We create the data solutions that help the company recruit great talent, build high-performing teams, and put real-time insights into the hands of decision-makers. At the intersection of data science, product development, and organizational psychology, we're changing how Robinhood uses data to support our employees and forecast organizational needs. As a PeopleX Insights & Analytics Intern, you'll work with our team to design and build high-impact data products that our leaders and managers rely on. You'll contribute to analyses that help us understand what allows talent to thrive, how to accelerate team performance, and how to build better retention strategies. This is a unique opportunity to apply cutting-edge language models and predictive analytics to meaningful work under the mentorship of a data scientist and our talent management team. Create high-fidelity visualizations and dashboards that translate complex organizational data into clear, executive-ready insights. Collaborate with the team on AI-driven workflows to automate the analysis and summarization of unstructured feedback and internal documentation. Ensure data integrity by defining metric dictionaries and maintaining a robust semantic layer for core People KPIs. items.title: Service Operations Manager
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE The Service Operations Manager is responsible for the reliable, continuous delivery of production monitoring and identity & access management services across LeoVegas. The role combines people leadership of a shift-based engineering team with operational ownership of access governance, ensuring both functions run with consistency, discipline, and clear escalation paths. This is a people-first leadership role. The manager owns team health, shift rhythm, process adherence, and cross-functional coordination, serving as the primary operational liaison between Service Operations and the rest of the Technical Operations department. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: Operational leadership & shift management - Own the day-to-day running of a 24/7 shift-based monitoring operation, ensuring handovers are structured and documented. - Maintain shift coverage, manage rota planning, and oversee escalation readiness at all times. - Act as the primary point of escalation for shift engineers during major incidents, supporting war room coordination and live documentation. - Ensure production monitoring activities align with agreed SLAs, detection standards, and escalation procedures. - Review and continuously improve shift handover quality, ensuring knowledge transfer between rotations. Identity & access management oversight - Oversee the onboarding and offboarding process for all company employees, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant access provisioning. - Ensure periodic access reviews are completed on schedule across all managed systems. - Maintain compliance with internal access policies and relevant regulatory requirements (MGA, UKGC, SPA, and others as applicable). - Act as the accountable owner for access governance, working with the Identity & Access Analysts to continuously improve procedures. Cross-functional coordination - Serve as the primary interface between Service Operations and the Incident Management function, ensuring events are correctly escalated, classified, and handed over. - Coordinate with Change Management on maintenance windows, PR reviews, and go-live readiness activities. - Work closely with the Observability & Engineering Manager to surface operational pain points, monitoring gaps, and manual toil that require tooling or automation investment. - Participate in new market and provider onboarding processes, maintaining checklists and ensuring regulatory notification requirements are met. People & performance management - Lead regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and development planning for all direct reports. - Manage team wellbeing and engagement, with particular attention to the challenges of shift-based working patterns. - Identify training needs and support certification or skills development where appropriate. - Onboard new team members effectively, maintaining and improving onboarding documentation. Process & governance - Own and maintain operational runbooks, escalation playbooks, and standard operating procedures for the Service Operations team. - Ensure all monitoring activities comply with the Datadog governance standards set by the Observability & Engineering team. - Support certification readiness activities by ensuring operational processes meet required compliance standards. - Conduct or facilitate post-shift reviews following major incidents, feeding findings into the wider incident management process. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: The essentials skills you bring to the team: - Proven experience managing a shift-based operations or NOC team in a 24/7 environment. - Strong understanding of production monitoring principles, event management, and incident escalation. - Experience managing identity & access management processes, including onboarding, offboarding, and access reviews. - Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a team of 8+ people across multiple disciplines. - Familiarity with ITIL frameworks, particularly Service Operation and Incident Management practices. - Strong communication skills, able to represent operational concerns clearly to senior stakeholders. Nice to have: - Previous experience in an iGaming, fintech, or regulated technology environment. - Hands-on experience with Datadog or equivalent observability platforms. - ITIL Foundation certification or above. - Experience working across multiple regulatory jurisdictions (SGA, MGA, UKGC, ADM, etc.). WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments. JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: Applied AI, Forward Deployed Machine Learning Engineer - (Internship)
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As an Applied Engineering Intern, you will work closely with our Applied AI Engineering team to facilitate the adoption of Mistral AI products among customers and collaborate with them to address complex technical challenges. This role is based in Paris, with an internship duration of 6 months. We are open to CIFRE programs as a continuation after the internship. What you will do • Contribute to the deployment of state-of-the-art GenAI applications, driving technological transformation with our customers. • Collaborate with researchers, AI engineers, and product engineers on complex customer projects. • Work with the product and science team to continuously improve our product and model capabilities based on customer feedback. How We Work in Applied AI - We care about people and outputs. - What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it - Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week. - Always ask why. items.title: B2B Marketing Manager, DACH
items.description: About the Team Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption. The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership. DACH is one of OpenAI’s most important markets in EMEA. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI. About the Role As the B2B Marketing Manager for DACH, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption. You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in DACH. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities. This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused DACH B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing. Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next. The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed. This role is preferably based in Munich. Berlin may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Regular travel within DACH and to London will be required. In this role, you will: - Own and execute the integrated DACH B2B marketing plan, aligned with regional priorities, local revenue goals, market opportunities, and customer needs. Partner closely with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead to ensure B2B and B2C strategies and activities are coordinated and complementary, while retaining clear accountability for B2B pipeline and revenue outcomes. - Carry pipeline goals for DACH B2B marketing and be accountable for demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline creation, influence, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes. - Partner closely with DACH Sales and GTM leadership on territory planning, target-account prioritisation, pipeline goals, strategic opportunities, and quarterly business reviews. - Build full-funnel programs across field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, content, customer advocacy, partnerships, events, and digital channels. - Design programs around priority accounts and buying groups, tailoring narratives and engagement for senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—and connecting customer proof, partner participation, content, and seller follow-up to create or advance opportunities. - Work in close partnership with Marketing Operations to define target audiences, establish campaigns, maintain data and process quality, track performance, improve attribution, and turn results into clear recommendations. - Build a regular Sales, Marketing, and Marketing Operations pacing rhythm covering pipeline performance, account engagement, campaign conversion, opportunity follow-up, risks, and investment decisions. - Translate global campaigns, product launches, narratives, and assets into locally relevant programs that reflect DACH market dynamics, language, industry priorities, and customer expectations. - Work with EMEA specialist teams in London to bring the strongest regional capabilities into the market, while serving as the voice of DACH in regional planning and prioritisation. - Develop locally relevant customer stories and advocacy opportunities in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Comms, and senior customer stakeholders. - Build joint programs with strategic technology, consulting, and implementation partners where they can extend reach, strengthen customer value, or contribute to pipeline. - Own the operating rhythm for DACH B2B marketing, including planning, budget management, agency coordination, campaign pacing, performance reporting, and prioritisation. - Build repeatable playbooks and share market learning across EMEA, helping the wider organisation understand what resonates with DACH customers and decision-makers. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 12+ years of experience in integrated B2B, regional, field, demand generation, or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise technology, cloud, AI, or SaaS. - Have a proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through integrated B2B marketing programs, ideally within large, complex enterprise sales cycles. - Have supported high-value products with long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and significant commercial scrutiny, and are familiar with engaging senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—throughout complex buying journeys. - Have held pipeline goals or comparable commercial targets and can clearly demonstrate how your marketing decisions created, influenced, or accelerated revenue opportunities. - Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and Sales leadership on account prioritisation, pipeline reviews, opportunity acceleration, executive engagement, and follow-up. - Have worked closely with Marketing Operations on campaign architecture, segmentation, lead and account processes, measurement, attribution, and performance reporting. - Are comfortable using pipeline and campaign data to diagnose performance, make trade-offs, and redirect investment—not simply report activity. - Are a marketing generalist with experience connecting multiple channels into one coherent market plan, rather than operating within a single specialist discipline, and have a strong track record of partnering with consumer marketing leaders to integrate B2B and B2C strategy and activity without blurring ownership. - Understand DACH enterprise buying dynamics and can translate local customer, industry, cultural, and regulatory context into stronger marketing decisions. - Can balance local market needs with regional and global priorities, influencing effectively within a matrixed international organisation. - Are both strategic and hands-on: able to establish direction and operating structure while personally driving high-priority work to completion. - Bring strong commercial judgement, operational discipline, and the ability to make clear prioritisation decisions when opportunities exceed available capacity. - Communicate credibly with senior customer decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—as well as Sales, Marketing, and partner stakeholders. - Are energised by AI and motivated to help organisations across DACH adopt transformative technology responsibly. - Are fluent in German and English. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain, the UK, or the UAE. Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact. For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home. 🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. items.title: Strategy & Operations Lead — Korea
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The APAC team is responsible for bringing OpenAI’s mission, products, and partnerships to life across one of the company’s most strategically important regions. As we scale our presence across Asia-Pacific, we are building a regional operating model that enables strong local execution, consistent global alignment, and long-term impact across businesses, products, markets, and functions. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Lead to lead and scale operational excellence in Korea. Reporting to the General Manager, Korea, this leader will work hand in hand with the General Manager to translate global strategy into regional execution, ensure operating discipline across markets and functions, and help the business scale with consistency, speed, and rigor. This person will act as a key bridge between global leadership and regional teams, bringing clarity to priorities, building scalable operating systems, and ensuring the region is set up to deliver against ambitious business goals while keeping the long-term opportunity in mind. This role is based in Seoul, Korea and we use a hybrid model of 3 days in office. YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Defining and implementing the Korea operating strategy in alignment with APAC & global objectives and regional priorities. - Driving execution across key markets, ensuring consistency while adapting to local needs, regulations, and market dynamics. - Partnering with global leadership to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and ensure strong execution in-region. - Establishing KPIs, reporting frameworks, and operating cadences to track performance and inform decision-making. - Building and optimizing scalable processes across business lines, including consumer, product, partnerships, and other key functions. - Identifying operational gaps and inefficiencies, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. - Supporting market entry strategies and operational readiness for Korea - Enabling strategic partnerships through strong operational frameworks and close partnership with relevant teams. - Helping build a strong regional functional leadership team and ensuring the regional operating system runs smoothly and efficiently. - Collaborating closely across functions to drive accountability and deliver against regional goals. - Ensuring seamless coordination between global and regional stakeholders. - Acting as a central point of accountability for operational delivery across Korea. - Building, leading, and mentoring a high-performing regional operations team. - Fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, operational rigor, and continuous learning. - Developing leadership bench strength across key markets and functions. WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WITH: - Significant experience leading regional or international operations in a fast-scaling, complex business environment. - Strong strategic and operational judgment, with the ability to translate high-level goals into clear execution plans. - Experience operating across multiple markets, functions, and business lines, ideally within Korea. - A track record of building scalable operating systems, processes, metrics, and reporting frameworks. - Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across global and regional teams. - Excellent business judgment, with a bias toward action and strong accountability for outcomes. - Experience supporting market expansion, operational readiness, and/or regional growth initiatives. - Strong people leadership skills, including experience building and developing high-performing teams. - Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure in fast-moving environments. - High integrity, low ego, and a collaborative leadership style. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bring clarity to complex topics. items.title: Doctorant·e CIFRE Data Science Personnalisation et Jeu Responsable F/H
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic est un acteur européen majeur du pari sportif et du jeu en ligne, proposant des activités de paris sportifs, de poker, de courses hippiques et de casino sur plusieurs marchés. Notre mission est de faire grandir la passion du sport et du jeu en proposant une expérience de divertissement innovante, dans un environnement sécurisé et responsable. Avec environ 1 600 collaborateurs répartis dans cinq pays et un siège basé à Bordeaux, Betclic est une entreprise internationale, moderne et profondément technologique. Chez Betclic, la Data n’est pas une fonction support : des dizaines de modèles et de produits data tournent en production et contribuent directement à l’expérience de millions de joueurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe Data Science de plus de dix personnes, dont quatre docteurs, qui travaille au quotidien avec les équipes Produit, Engineering, MLOps et Jeu Responsable. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 Cette opportunité combine un programme de recherche ambitieux avec un environnement industriel concret : • Une thèse CIFRE de 3 ans avec un CDI dès l’embauche • Un sujet de recherche directement lié au jeu responsable et à des décisions produit concrètes • Des données comportementales et transactionnelles à grande échelle, des systèmes de recommandation en production et un environnement d’expérimentation • Un environnement international et créatif dans lequel la Data Science a un impact visible • Un accès à Claude et une culture encourageant l’usage responsable de l’IA générative pour la recherche, le prototypage, l’analyse et la rédaction ENTER THE GAME 🎮 En tant que doctorant·e CIFRE, vous rejoindrez l’équipe Data Science de Betclic et travaillerez sur un sujet à l’intersection de la modélisation séquentielle, de la personnalisation, des sciences comportementales et du jeu responsable. La thèse sera menée en partenariat avec le laboratoire IMS Bordeaux et l’ENSC Bordeaux INP. Le ou la doctorant·e sera inscrit·e à l’école doctorale Sciences Physiques et de l’Ingénieur (SPI) de l’Université de Bordeaux. La question centrale est la suivante : comment comprendre ce qu’un joueur cherche à faire à un instant donné, plutôt que seulement ce qu’il a aimé dans le passé, afin d’adapter son expérience en temps réel tout en donnant la priorité à sa protection ? YOUR RO LE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 Le sujet de thèse proposé est : « De la pertinence de l’item au pilotage de l’expérience : comprendre l’état de session d’un joueur pour personnaliser l’expérience en temps réel, sous contraintes de jeu responsable. » Le sujet sera précisé avec le ou la candidat·e retenu·e et le laboratoire académique avant le dépôt du dossier auprès de l’ANRT. Vos travaux de recherche s’articuleront autour de trois objectifs complémentaires : • Estimer un état de session latent à partir de séquences d’événements incomplètes, en tenant compte de l’incertitude et des changements de régime comportemental. • Dépasser le simple classement d’items et étudier une politique d’adaptation au niveau de l’expérience, capable de choisir entre plusieurs actions : recommander, informer, favoriser la découverte, ou ne rien pousser. • Intégrer le jeu responsable comme contrainte prioritaire de la décision, à partir de signaux précoces, incertains et évolutifs observés au cours de la session. Le travail s’appuiera sur la comparaison de deux environnements contrastés, les paris sportifs et le Casino, ainsi que sur un accès direct à des systèmes en cours de déploiement en production. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 Nous recherchons une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, qui apprécie les problèmes ouverts et souhaite relier recherche scientifique et impact concret. • Vous êtes titulaire, ou bientôt titulaire, d’un Master 2 ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur en statistiques, mathématiques appliquées, Data Science, Machine Learning, informatique, cognitique ou dans un domaine proche. • Vous êtes récemment diplômé·e ou disposez d’une à deux années d’expérience en industrie en Data Science, Machine Learning, R&D ou analyse de données, et souhaitez vous engager dans une thèse. • Vous avez une réelle appétence pour les statistiques, la modélisation et l’analyse de données comportementales. • Vous êtes intéressé·e par la cognition, les intentions, les comportements humains ou les interactions entre individus et systèmes numériques. • Vous savez formuler des hypothèses, construire un protocole expérimental et interpréter rigoureusement des résultats. • Vous êtes à l’aise avec Python et disposez de bonnes bases en SQL. • Vous communiquez clairement avec des interlocuteurs scientifiques, techniques et métier. • Vous êtes autonome, curieux·se, rigoureux·se et appréciez le travail collaboratif. Une expérience ou des connaissances en recommandation, personnalisation, modèles séquentiels ou probabilistes, états latents, quantification de l’incertitude, évaluation de systèmes adaptatifs, sciences cognitives ou jeu responsable seront appréciées. Une appétence pour le sport, le gaming ou les environnements produits est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous aurez d’abord un échange avec les Ressources Humaines, puis un entretien avec le Head of Data Science consacré à votre parcours, vos motivations et au sujet de thèse. Vous échangerez ensuite avec les encadrants académiques lors d’un entretien scientifique, avant un dernier entretien RH. Le processus pourra être adapté au profil du ou de la candidat·e et à l’avancement du projet CIFRE. Le sujet présenté constitue une base de travail : vos intérêts scientifiques et vos premières propositions contribueront à construire le programme de recherche final avec Betclic et le laboratoire académique. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 • Un CDI dès l’embauche dans le cadre d’une thèse CIFRE de 3 ans • Une rémunération attractive positionnée au niveau d’un poste de Junior Data Scientist chez Betclic • Un double encadrement industriel et académique au sein d’une équipe Data Science expérimentée et collaborative • Des données réelles, des systèmes en production et un environnement d’A/B testing • 25 jours de congés payés et 10 jours de RTT • Une carte Ticket Restaurant® créditée de 11 € par jour, dont 6 € pris en charge par Betclic • Une mutuelle santé prise en charge à 100 % pour vous et vos enfants • 50 % de remboursement des transports en commun ou une indemnité annuelle de mobilité durable • Un modèle de télétravail hybride et l’accès à un large catalogue de formation • Des cours de sport sur site, des événements internes et des locaux avec rooftop et vue sur la Cité du Vin CDI basé à Bordeaux Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.title: ASO Specialist
items.description: Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation. Who we are We’re Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands, including Betway and Jackpot City. We’re a powerhouse built on decades of expertise and we’re changing the game for good. Our mission is to give our customers a superclass entertainment experience. Who we’re looking for We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Super Group International, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar. Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary. Why we need you We’re building experiences that wow our customers – and that starts with bold, curious people who want to do work that matters. If you’re hungry to grow, excited by impact and ready for a challenge that will supercharge your career, this could be your moment. The ASO Specialist will drive mobile marketing efforts across 15+ brands, promoting iOS and Android apps with a global presence. Working alongside another ASO team member, this role is responsible for delivering impactful results through user acquisition strategies, conversion rate optimizations, and continuous support for app release and updates. What you’ll do You’ll take ownership of work that gives us our competitive edge, including: Own and optimize our apps across all markets, primarily on the App Store and Play Store. Develop and execute ASO strategies to enhance app visibility, increase downloads, and improve conversion rates. Optimize metadata including titles, descriptions, keywords, and visual assets, to boost visibility, rankings, and user acquisition. Run A/B tests on store assets and analyze results to inform ongoing optimization. Drive mobile innovation by staying up to date with the latest ASO trends, platform updates, and industry best practices. Conduct in-depth competitor analysis to uncover trends and growth opportunities. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align ASO efforts with regular app release cycles and ensure readiness. Support the launch of new apps, features, and updates with tailored ASO strategies. Partner with product and marketing teams to drive promotions, including In-App Events. Manage multiple projects and timelines while coordinating with relevant stakeholders. Maintain strong and effective cross-team collaborations and relationships. Briefing, management, and research of projects in relevant systems. Maintain app store accounts and manage user access across all platforms. The conceptualization and implementation of ideas throughout the business. Ensure internal documentation and knowledge bases are regularly updated with new and existing processes. Manage communications with suppliers, agencies, and strategic partners. This list covers your core responsibilities – with plenty of room to stretch, explore and take on new challenges as we grow. What you’ll bring You’re someone who brings: Minimum 1 years’ working experience managing ASO on the App Store and Google Play, or relevant marketing experience. Experience managing apps on the App Store and Play Store Experience developing and executing successful ASO strategies that drive measurable results. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex ASO results into clear, actionable insights. Highly analytical with experience using ASO and app performance tools such as AppTweak, SensorTower, App Store Connect, and Google Play Console. Proficient in reporting and data visualization using tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Excel. Effective cross-functional collaborator, able to work seamlessly with performance marketing, creative, product, and analytics teams. Exceptional attention to detail, with strong organizational and prioritization skills Desirable skills you’ve got up your sleeve It would be great if you also have some the following skills: In-depth knowledge of sports betting markets, including odds calculation, betting types and market trends Previous experience in the online gaming or casino industry, with a strong understanding of player behaviour and industry regulations Familiarity with gambling regulations and compliance requirements in various jurisdictions, ensuring adherence to legal standards A passion for and knowledge of casino games. Experience in iGaming, regulated industries, or working with fast-paced digital products. items.title: Enforcement Operations Lead, Cloud Partners
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic's Safeguards team is responsible for enforcing our policies, protecting users, and ensuring our platform is not misused. A large and growing share of Claude usage reaches customers through our cloud partners: Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. As the Enforcement Operations Lead for Multi-Cloud, you'll own how Anthropic detects, reviews, and acts on misuse across those surfaces, where the partner owns the customer relationship and often the data path. You'll build the operating model, partner agreements, and documentation that make enforcement on every cloud consistent, auditable, and fast. This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of coordinating across teams and companies to break new ground and drive work to completion. This work is deeply cross-functional. You'll partner closely with our product managers, policy experts, Safeguards engineering, Legal, and the trust & safety and operations teams across our Cloud partners to maintain a consistent and safe enforcement ecosystem. Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. Key responsibilities Own the end to end enforcement lifecycle on partner surfaces, from detection and review through action, customer communication, and appeal Define enforcement paths for each partner's operating model, including how actions are requested, executed, and confirmed when the partner controls the account Manage SLAs for review, escalation, and action, and evaluate performance against them on an ongoing basis Develop and maintain SOPs and escalation guides for all enforcement workflows, ensuring consistency across clouds Establish red-teaming, Quality processes, and operationalize shared metrics Stand up paired investigations with partner threat intelligence teams, including case referrals, indicator sharing, and paging for high severity incidents Own enforcement metrics across partner surfaces and report them to Safeguards leadership, partners, and regulators Minimum qualifications Extensive experience in trust and safety operations, enforcement, threat intelligence, or a related field Have managed external partner or vendor relationships where you did not control the other side's systems or priorities Comfortable working across policy, legal, engineering, and operations teams to translate requirements into practical workflows Experience building enforcement programs from the ground up, including SLAs, escalation paths, and quality measurement Highly organized, with a track record of maintaining rigorous documentation and SOPs in fast-moving environments Clear and precise communication, both in writing and verbally, across technical and non-technical audiences, including partner executives Energized by the challenge of building scalable systems in an environment where not everything is already figured out Care deeply about the responsible deployment of AI and the role enforcement operations plays in that mission Preferred qualifications Direct trust & safety, abuse, or security operations experience at AWS, GCP, or Azure, or at a company that ships through their marketplaces Experience designing incident response or escalation processes that span more than one company Familiarity with data access controls, audit requirements, or privacy constrained review environments Experience with law enforcement referrals, regulatory reporting, or compliance programs Background in AI safety, content moderation, fraud, or abuse detection systems Comfort working with data and metrics to inform operational decisions and surface trends to leadership The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $285,000 — $330,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

This requires a breadth of new ML research to address the growing set of safety challenges as AI becomes more powerful and used in more settings. items.title: Technical Architect
items.location_text: Remote-Friendly (Travel-Required) | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude Code is changing how engineering organizations build software, and most of them need someone to show them how. That's you. Technical Architects help customers get real work done with Claude Code, Claude Tag (Claude Code as an agent in Slack), and the enterprise admin controls that decide whether a rollout succeeds. You'll teach customers, partners and Anthropic's own field teams. Just as important, you'll train the trainers who carry that knowledge to everyone else. We're hands-on AI engineers who would rather teach than sell. You'll work alongside customer engineering organizations, teaching them about Claude Code and shepherding rollouts with advanced admin knowledge. Most weeks you're in front of an audience with Claude Desktop or a terminal open: thousands of engineers on a public webinar one day, a customer's platform team in their own conference room the next week, office hours in between. The prep material often reaches you the day before. The team is growing quickly this year, scope will grow as new products ship, and the people who join now will shape how it works. Responsibilities Teach in every format. Take a standing rotation on Anthropic's public webinars in front of thousands of engineers at a time. Lead workshops and multi-day onsites, in person and virtual, built around a customer's own codebase and questions. Host office hours and multi-week cohorts where engineers, partners, and account teams bring live problems. Teach the teachers. Run train-the-trainer programs for customer technologists and champions, and certify them to deliver Anthropic's material. Empower admins. Educate enterprise admins on the technical requirements for a strong rollout by guiding them through single sign-on, permissions, connectors, spend controls, data-handling policy, and other advanced topics. Build fast with Claude. Turn a request into a polished deck, demo repository or plugin within a day, using the tools you teach. Explore new features the day they ship. Pick up a teammate's material and deliver it as if you wrote it. Bring field signal back to product. Tell the Claude Code, Claude Tag and Cowork teams what customers run into, specifically enough that they can fix it. Be the technical voice in the room. Partner with account executives, customer success managers, Applied AI Architects, support engineers and partner leads. Travel. Expect 30 to 50%, in bursts around onsites, workshops and events. You may be a good fit if you have 5+ years as a software engineer, solutions architect, developer advocate or similar. You still ship code and regularly teach engineering audiences. Current engineering range. You've shipped code other people depend on. You can go deep with a senior engineer anywhere in the stack. You use Claude Code or a similar agentic tool every day and have opinions about it. Big-stage presence. You've held large live audiences. You sound practiced with material you got that morning, and a broken demo doesn’t faze you. Range in one conversation. You can go from banter to a rigorous design discussion, and both feel natural. Care for people. You do right by a struggling customer, and you won't leave a confused room behind. Initiative. You build things without waiting for permission, and you say when an idea is half-formed, including your manager's. Steadiness when priorities shift, timelines are short and colleagues are under pressure. Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving industry and product suite. A stake in safe AI. You care that large organizations deploy AI responsibly, and you want to help them do it. You love being on the frontier. You want to work at the edge of what’s possible and help define what comes next. Strong candidates may also have Depth in enterprise identity and security review (SAML, OIDC, SCIM, SOC 2, HIPAA). Experience running Claude on Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud Vertex AI. Time with regulated industries or with systems-integrator partners. A public record of technical teaching: talks, courses, videos or writing. An interest outside technology you can talk about with the same energy. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $250,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Research Engineer, AI for Chip Design
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI develops models that can reason through complex problems and hardware designed for the demands of advanced AI. AI for Chips connects these efforts: applying increasingly capable AI systems to the work of semiconductor engineering. Our goal is to help engineers develop better chips and shorten design cycles. This work brings research, model training, and hardware expertise together to build tools that engineers can use on real designs, with correctness and measurable performance at the center. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring a Research Engineer to help OpenAI models solve chip-design problems through reinforcement learning, tool use, and evaluation. You’ll own experiments from the initial idea through implementation and analysis. That means building environments and evaluations, running training, investigating failures, and using the results to decide what to try next. You’ll also build the software needed to make those experiments reliable and reproducible. We value strong coding fundamentals, careful experimental judgment, and the ability to make progress independently. Prior chip-design experience is helpful, but you can learn the domain alongside the team’s hardware specialists. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Build RL environments and evaluations for tasks such as RTL generation, design verification, and physical design optimization. - Develop and test approaches that help models use chip-design tools and improve power, performance, and area while preserving correctness. - Design experiments, establish baselines, and measure whether improvements hold up on new tasks and designs. - Investigate failures across model behavior, rewards, evaluation tools, and experiment infrastructure. - Improve iteration speed through better tooling, faster evaluations, and proxy rewards that reflect the outcomes we care about. - Turn successful experiments into reusable research code and training workflows, working closely with researchers and engineers. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have strong programming and debugging skills and a track record of turning technical ideas into working software. - Experience with reinforcement learning, model evaluations, post-training, or other applied ML research. - Experience building tool-using agents, reward functions, or automated evaluation systems. - Can form clear hypotheses, design useful experiments, and distinguish meaningful results from noise or evaluation errors. - Work independently on ambiguous problems and make practical decisions about what to build or test next. - Stay close to the implementation and can explain what you built, what failed, and what you learned. - Communicate progress clearly and collaborate well with people across research, software, and hardware. - Care about developing safe, beneficial AI. NICE TO HAVE: - Familiarity with experiment orchestration, distributed training, or research infrastructure. - Experience with RTL, Verilog/SystemVerilog, EDA tools, formal verification, or chip-design automation. To comply with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidates for this role may need to meet certain legal status requirements as provided in those laws and regulations. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior Strategic Program Lead on the Strategic Programs team within Customer Experience, you'll own the customer experience strategy for Coinbase's most critical onboarding journeys: identity verification, account recovery, login, and new-user KYC. This team sits at the intersection of Product and CX, focused on turning customer friction into prioritized product work and measurable improvements. You'll partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Design to influence roadmaps with customer-grounded data, making these first-impression moments seamless. What you'll do: Own the end-to-end CX strategy and program management for Identity and Onboarding, building and operationalizing long-term plans informed by customer feedback, contact rate analysis, business priorities and market trends. Build and maintain program scorecards tracking contact rates, CSAT, automation effectiveness, and quality guardrails, using them to frame product opportunities with clear impact sizing and prioritized recommendations. Drive launch readiness for Identity and Onboarding product releases, ensuring sad path experiences are fully scoped in partnership with Product, determine instrumentation requirements for our operational teams and leverage AI to build and ship features. As an Operations Excellence Senior Program Lead on the CX Operations Excellence team, you'll own and optimize the workflows, routing logic, and agent tooling that power Coinbase's global Customer Experience operation. This team designs the CX operating system, covering end-to-end workflows, SOPs, routing, and tooling across Scaled Operations and Premium and Wealth, directly tied to CSAT, retention, FCR, and handle time. You'll turn ambiguous, multi-year CX goals into a clear portfolio of programs that measurably improve quality, efficiency, and the Specialist experience across in-house and BPO sites worldwide. What you'll do: Own program strategy for broadly scoped CX operations initiatives, translating business problems into structured plans and driving execution from discovery through global rollout while managing trade-offs between time, scope, and cost. Design and optimize end-to-end CX workflows, from contact entry points and routing logic through Specialist handling and resolution, to reduce friction, standardize experiences across sites and vendors, and ensure the right work reaches the right Specialist. Partner with Product, Tooling, WFM, Analytics, and Operations to shape queue design, case allocation rules, channel strategy, and automation/AI use cases that maximize productivity without sacrificing quality. Build and maintain CX standards and governance, including SOPs, playbooks, dashboards, and process excellence frameworks that provide a single source of truth for how workflows and tools operate across regions and partners. Drive change management at scale by crafting communications, enablement plans, and feedback loops that land new workflows, routing strategies, and tools with global teams and ensure continuous improvement. Leverage operational metrics, quality outcomes, CSAT/effort scores, and capacity data to identify opportunity areas, size problems, set targets, and validate whether workflow and tooling changes deliver expected results. Required Skills and Experience: 7+ years in customer support operations, process excellence, or program management, with a track record designing and scaling CX workflows in multi-product, multi-geo environments. Proven experience designing end-to-end workflows, SOPs, and routing logic across multiple teams, geographies, or vendor partners in high-volume operations (case management, contact routing, agent desktops, automation). Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional programs involving 4+ stakeholder teams (Operations, Product, Engineering, Analytics, WFM) from discovery through measurable impact. items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is looking for a Staff Android Engineer to help build a world-class trading app on Android. Millions of users follow markets, track positions, and make trades on their phones — and the Android experience needs to match that level of engagement. This is a high-ownership, high-influence role for someone who has operated at the staff level before and knows what it means to shape a platform, not just build on it. You'll set the technical direction for Android at Polymarket, raise the bar across the codebase, and help take a product that's already at scale to the next level. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Set the technical direction for Android at Polymarket, making and owning architectural decisions that the team builds around - Build and own Android features spanning payments flows, real-time market data, and core UI with full accountability from design handoff through to production - Implement polished, performant interfaces with Jetpack Compose that hold up under real trading conditions and meet a high bar for feel and reliability - Own CI/CD pipelines and Gradle configuration, keeping the build fast and the release process reliable as the team and product grow - Build and maintain integrations across WebSockets, gRPC, and streaming data to power the live market features traders depend on - Operate as a technical leader across a distributed team: communicate clearly, make decisions without hand-holding, and raise the engineering bar through code reviews and strong engineering standards - Actively incorporate AI tools into your development workflow to move faster and maintain a high output bar - Identify and address gaps in Android architecture and engineering practices before they become problems at scale WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Significant Android engineering experience, with a track record of owning and shaping Android platforms at scale, not just contributing to them - Strong, current expertise in Kotlin with the ability to speak concretely to tradeoffs and make architectural calls with confidence - Deep experience building production UI with Jetpack Compose and a high bar for performance and polish - Experience owning CI/CD pipelines and Gradle build configuration end-to-end - Solid understanding of modern Android architecture with the judgment to evolve it as the product scales - A track record of technical leadership: you've influenced how an engineering team works, not just what it ships - Active use of AI tools in your development workflow, not occasionally, but as a real part of how you work - (Plus) Experience integrating payments on Android - (Plus) Experience with WebSockets, gRPC, or other real-time data patterns on mobile - (Plus) Familiarity with cross-platform shared-code architectures - (Plus) iOS or Swift experience - (Plus) Background at a larger, more mature engineering organization where you saw and shaped practices as the company grew BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

This person will help us identify the right companies and people, understand why they are relevant, determine the right next action, and learn from what happens afterward. Own the prospecting function for the ads business, serving SMB Ads while building a foundation reusable across segments. Set the vision, operating model, roadmap, platform choices, business rules, adoption, and outcomes; and partner with Ads Engineering, Data Science, and internal platform teams. Decide what to build in-house, enable through internal platforms, or deliver through selected vendors and partners. In This Role, You Will - Lead the function’s strategy, roadmap, operating model, and adoption. Connect platform investments to measurable advertiser and business outcomes. - Define a unified prospect, account, contact, and advertiser data model. Establish standards for identity, data quality, provenance, freshness, confidence, and consent. - Combine market, intent, behavioral, product, CRM, campaign, and customer-success signals to improve targeting and customer engagement. - Design enrichment and verification workflows. Evaluate in-house capabilities, platforms, vendors, APIs, AI, and human review to select effective solutions. - Develop scoring and next-best-action models using customer fit, intent, activity, reachability, lifecycle stage, and growth potential. - Connect intelligence to action across sales, marketing, product, paid media, partners, and lifecycle journeys through coordinated routing and activation. - Enable marketers to create audiences, configure triggered journeys, run experiments, and execute campaigns through intuitive systems with quality checks and approvals. - Build feedback loops that use outreach, engagement, conversion, spend, retention, churn, and customer-success outcomes to improve targeting and lifecycle decisions. - Measure data quality, coverage, targeting accuracy, deliverability, conversion, and incremental value. Establish permissions, suppression, auditability, and provider-performance standards. You Might Thrive in This Role If You - Bring substantial experience building go-to-market systems, customer-data products, growth platforms, lifecycle infrastructure, revenue systems, or marketing technology. - Demonstrate ownership of platforms that connect data, decisions, and workflows to measurable commercial outcomes. - Apply strong product judgment to prioritize opportunities, define useful solutions, and sequence delivery. - Translate identity resolution, enrichment, scoring, segmentation, routing, experimentation, and feedback loops into clear system requirements. - Design practical solutions with marketers and sales teams, grounded in their campaign and customer workflows. - Explore data and test ideas with tools such as analytics platforms, SQL, APIs, automation, or AI-assisted prototyping. Production engineering experience is not required. - Evaluate build, buy, and integration choices across CRM, marketing automation, customer data platforms, and campaign-execution systems. - Lead a small team and build alignment with senior cross-functional partners. - Apply sound judgment to privacy, consent, deliverability, data rights, governance, and customer trust. - Bring relevant experience in advertising, SMB or self-serve businesses, product-led SaaS, marketplaces, commerce, fintech, enterprise go-to-market, or other multi-segment customer journeys. Preferred Qualifications - Experience building prospecting or customer intelligence platforms for advertising, SMB, or self-serve businesses. - Track record combining customer and intent data to improve targeting and conversion. - Experience deploying enrichment, scoring, and next-best-action models across marketing and sales. - Experience integrating data vendors, CRM, marketing automation, and customer data platforms. - Hands-on experience using SQL, APIs, automation, or AI to validate growth solutions. - Experience building feedback loops and governance practices that improve performance, data quality, and trust. Workplace & Location - San Francisco, CA. This role requires a hybrid schedule with an in office requirement from Monday - Wednesday. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways. The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth. About the Role We are looking for a Scaled Programs Lead to build and scale global programs that engage SMB-focused agencies and other partners helping small and medium-sized businesses grow. This is a zero-to-one opportunity to shape how these audiences discover, understand and adopt OpenAI’s advertising solutions. You will develop programs that build awareness, recruit participants, strengthen their capabilities and help them bring the advertising opportunity to their SMB customers. Your remit will span audience segmentation, recruitment campaigns, education, certification, incentives and co-marketing. You will design and launch new programs, validate their impact and scale the approaches that deliver meaningful results. Working across Marketing, Partnerships, Sales, Product and Operations, you will combine strategic judgment with hands-on execution. As the programs grow, you will build and lead a team to expand them globally. items.title: Senior Director, Solutions Architecture — Americas
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! As the Senior Director of Solutions Architecture for the Americas at Cohere, you will own the US and Canada commercial Solutions Architecture function. You will lead the team that turns enterprise interest in agentic AI into deployed, production systems, and you will be accountable for the technical win in the most competitive AI market in the world. The United States and Canada are our largest commercial opportunity, and this seat owns how we win them. You will take an established, distributed team of strong technical people and raise what it can do — setting the bar and establishing the operating rhythm that lets a team of generalists run consistent, industry-fluent plays at enterprise scale. You will set direction for the function, sit on the Solution Architecture leadership team alongside the regional leaders for EMEA and Asia Pacific, and contribute to company-wide decisions with your peers across Sales, Product and Engineering. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Lead and Scale the Organization: Build, coach and develop a high-performing Solutions Architecture organization across the US and Canada, and grow the senior technical talent within it. - Own the Technical Win: Be personally accountable for the technical outcome of the region’s most strategic pursuits, and be in the room for the ones that decide the year. - Own the US Market: Lead how Cohere positions, proves and sells into US enterprises — our largest commercial opportunity, and the market this seat is measured on. - Extend Our Reach: Grow the share of the region’s pipeline the team is technically leading, and make sure we are engaged early on the opportunities that matter most. - Own the Number with Sales: Partner with regional Sales leadership as a co-owner of the region’s number, not as a support function to it. - Set Direction for the Function: Define the vision, strategy and operating model for Americas Solutions Architecture, and hold your leaders accountable for delivery and execution against it. - Build Repeatable Solution Practices: Establish scalable solution-selling methodologies, industry playbooks, executive narratives, business cases and technical delivery frameworks that improve consistency and win rates. - Architect Enterprise AI Solutions: Guide customers in designing secure, scalable, production-ready agentic AI solutions across cloud, hybrid, VPC and on-premises environments. - Shape Product Direction: Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer feedback and market needs into platform improvements and roadmap priorities. - Attract Talent to Cohere: Bring senior technical field talent with you and continue to attract it. Building the bench is part of the job, not a consequence of it. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Lead and develop the Americas commercial Solutions Architecture team through coaching, hiring, performance management and career development. - Partner with regional Sales leadership to pursue and close strategic enterprise opportunities across financial services, healthcare, energy, technology and other key verticals. - Own the region’s technical coverage model, and ensure the team is engaged early and consistently on the opportunities that matter most. - Lead executive workshops, discovery sessions, solution presentations and technical deep dives with C-suite and senior customer stakeholders. - Develop business cases, solution architectures, implementation roadmaps and technical proposals that align customer objectives with Cohere’s platform. - Guide customers through the deployment of enterprise AI solutions, ensuring scalability, security, governance and operational readiness. - Create repeatable solution assets, industry playbooks and best practices that enable the team to consistently deliver high-quality customer engagements. - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales and Customer Success to ensure alignment between customer needs and platform evolution, and contribute to decisions that reach beyond your own function. - Serve as the voice of the field by capturing customer feedback and competitive insights that influence product strategy. - Own and report on the region’s operational and commercial metrics, including technical win rates, pipeline health, coverage and team performance. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR: - Leadership Experience: 15+ years in Solutions Architecture, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting or Enterprise Architecture, including 7+ years leading customer-facing technical teams, and a record of developing people into senior and leadership roles. - People Leadership: A proven record of hiring, coaching and developing high-performing Solutions Architecture or Solutions Engineering teams, and of building or transforming an organization rather than inheriting a healthy one. - Executive Presence: You command a room. You are credible in front of a CEO and their business leaders, the people who own the problem and the budget, and equally credible in front of a Chief Information Officer, a Chief AI Officer or a Chief Information Security Officer. You can move between the business case and the architecture without losing either audience. - Hands-On Technical Credibility: You are technical enough to be believed by a strong engineering bench. You work with models and agents yourself, you can pressure-test your team’s architecture, and you can be the most useful person in a design conversation when it matters. This is a player-coach seat, not an overlay. - Commercial Acumen: A demonstrated ability to partner with enterprise Sales leadership, influence strategic deals, and articulate business value to executive stakeholders. You have carried a number and can point to deals you personally moved. - Consulting Mindset: Experience leading complex enterprise solution engagements, developing business cases, implementation plans and executive-ready recommendations. - Technical Expertise: A strong understanding of modern AI architectures, including large language models, agentic systems, retrieval, enterprise integrations, cloud platforms, hybrid and on-premises deployments, security and governance. - Enterprise Experience: Experience designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions in complex, regulated or large-scale environments. - Cross-Functional Influence: A record of contributing to decisions beyond your own function, and of working effectively with Product and Engineering leadership. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: - Experience building or turning around a regional technical field organization, and evidence of what changed as a result. - Background in enterprise AI, cloud, or data platform companies, or applied AI consulting organizations. - Experience supporting customers in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, energy, or the public sector. - Experience building repeatable solution-selling methodologies and helping generalist technical teams operate at a consistently high level. - A network of senior technical field talent you can attract to Cohere. - Experience operating in high-growth environments where speed, ownership and cross-functional collaboration are critical. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.
